review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for maintaining system availability, performance, reliability, and security; troubleshoots complex issues; improves automation and disaster recovery readiness; and partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application, and business teams. The Cybersecurity team defines and approves security policy, while this role implements, operates, and maintains approved controls. Duties And Responsibilities Systems, Cloud, and Identity: Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure
eligibility_evidence: Position Summary The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) seeks a Infrastructure Engineer to support, secure, and modernize enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, data center, server, identity, network, wireless, backup, and Microsoft 365 environments.

Duties And Responsibilities Systems, Cloud, and Identity: Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, SQL databases, Microsoft 365 integrations, and related hybrid services.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with Nutanix Acropolis, Microsoft Azure administration, hybrid cloud connectivity, Commvault, Palo Alto Networks, Arista or Cisco switching, and Aruba wireless infrastructure.
Work Environment and Additional Requirements: On-site presence at NAR's DC office three days per week.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience. Five or more years of experience as a Systems Engineer or Infrastructure Engineer, or similar enterprise infrastructure role. Hands-on knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, firewall administration, enterprise security principles, PowerShell automation, and monitoring and alerting platforms. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Nutanix Acropolis, Microsoft Azure administration, hybrid cloud connectivity, Commvault, Palo Alto Networks, Arista or Cisco switching, and Aruba wireless infrastructure. Work Environment and Additional Requirements: On-site presence at NAR's DC office three days per week.
